headline: Google's Pixel Buds update will put them to sleep along with you
summary: Google Pixel Buds 2A and Pro 2 receive a new update with sleep detection. The update integrates with the Pixel Watch for advanced sleep tracking. New features, including dynamic ANC and tap-to-mute, are rolling out now.

headline: AI could upend food delivery
summary: A startup named Bites is challenging giants like DoorDash with AI-powered delivery. Bites uses agentic AI to automate food delivery processes. This technology aims to significantly disrupt the traditional food delivery model.

headline: At $1,279, Google's Xreal Aura will go head-to-head with Meta's VR Glasses
summary: Google's Xreal Aura AR glasses are now available for pre-order at $1,279. These transparent XR glasses are built in partnership with Xreal. They are positioned to compete directly with Meta's recently revealed VR Glasses.

headline: Google now lets you make games with AI
summary: Google launched Playground, a new browser-based platform for creating games. Users can make custom games using AI prompts, no coding required. The experimental platform is available in the US for users aged 18+.

headline: New Ape Escape Reportedly in Development at Sonic Mania Team
summary: A new Ape Escape game is reportedly in development. The project is being handled by the team behind Sonic Mania. Fans anticipate a successful reboot from the experienced team.

headline: Resident Evil Requiem Writer Teases DLC Plans, Immediately Says He Probably Shouldn't Have
summary: Screenwriter Haris Orkin hinted at future DLC for Resident Evil Requiem. Orkin quickly expressed regret over revealing the information. This suggests new content is likely planned for the game.

headline: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 Dev Says It's Got More Single-Player Content Than Any Other RTS Ever at Launch
summary: Dawn of War 4 is touted for its extensive single-player campaign. Developer King Art Games claims it surpasses previous series titles in content. The game aims to have more single-player content than any other RTS at launch.

headline: The Acer Nitro Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC Drops to Just $1,699 for Prime Day
summary: The Acer Nitro Radeon RX 9070 XT gaming PC is on sale for $1,699. This Prime Day deal highlights its strong 4K gaming performance. The RX 9070 XT performance rivals more expensive GeForce RTX 5070 Ti.

headline: Man admits sexually assaulting woman drugged by husband
summary: A man confessed to sexually assaulting a woman who was drugged. The woman was allegedly incapacitated by her husband. The husband is accused of inviting multiple men to abuse her.

headline: How did Christa Pike survive two lethal injections - and what happens now?
summary: Convicted killer Christa Pike reportedly survived two lethal injection attempts. She is currently awake and speaking in a Tennessee hospital. Authorities are now evaluating the next steps for her execution.

headline: Royal Mail plans to cut 2,500 jobs
summary: Royal Mail announced plans to reduce its workforce by 2,500 jobs. The cuts will target head office and non-frontline roles. The company aims to complete the job reductions by the end of 2027.

headline: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
summary: France suspended the use of stun grenades in policing. The decision follows an incident where a boy lost his hand during protests. Groups had complained about disproportionate police force against teenagers.
